rows.question: What is the return window for an opened item?
rows.answer: Opened items can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and a 15% restocking fee applies to opened items. Unused items in their original packaging can be returned for a refund within 30 days of delivery.
sources: Promotions and discounts > Black Friday and holiday returns

rows.question: How much does a prepaid return label cost me?
rows.answer: For all other returns we deduct 8.95 USD from the refund for a prepaid US return label. If you refuse a parcel that was not damaged, the return is treated as a normal return and the 8.95 USD return label cost applies.

rows.question: How long is the warranty on the Lumen Buds Lite?
rows.answer: Lumen Buds Lite and Lumen Mini Speaker carry a 1-year limited warranty. Lumen Buds Pro and Lumen Studio Over-Ear carry a 2-year limited warranty from the delivery date.

rows.question: What does express shipping cost and how fast is it?
rows.answer: Express shipping costs 14.95 USD and arrives in 1 to 2 business days when the order is placed before the 2pm ET cut-off. Same-day and express shipping are not available at these addresses.
sources: Shipping and delivery > Remote US addresses
Shipping and delivery > Domestic shipping options

rows.question: How many countries do you ship to?
rows.answer: The warranty is valid in the 12 countries we ship to, through local service partners. We ship to 12 countries: Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, the Netherlands, Sweden, Australia, New Zealand and Japan.

rows.question: Can I cancel an order that is already with the carrier?
rows.answer: Support cannot change a shipping address after an order reaches packing, cannot cancel a parcel already with the carrier, and cannot issue a refund to a different payment method from the one used for the order.
sources: Contacting support > What support cannot do
Account and privacy > Deleting your account

rows.question: How long is a password reset link valid?
rows.answer: A password reset link is valid for 30 minutes and can be used once. The export is prepared within 30 days and sent as a download link valid for 7 days.
sources: Account and privacy > Exporting your data

rows.question: When is my card actually charged?
rows.answer: Your card is charged when the order ships, not when it is placed.
sources: Payments and billing > When you are charged

rows.question: What discount do students get?
rows.answer: The student discount cannot be combined with sale items or with the Black Friday event.

rows.question: Which cities have same-day delivery?
rows.answer: Same-day delivery is available in New York City, Los Angeles and Chicago for 24.95 USD on orders placed before 11am local time. Same-day delivery is not available on Sundays.
sources: Shipping and delivery > Domestic shipping options
Shipping and delivery > Remote US addresses

rows.question: I opened my Lumen Buds Pro and want to send them back within 14 days. How much will I actually get back?
rows.answer: Opened items can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and a 15% restocking fee applies to opened items. Lumen Buds Pro and Lumen Studio Over-Ear carry a 2-year limited warranty from the delivery date.

rows.question: What is the last date I can return something I bought on Black Friday?
rows.answer: The Black Friday event runs from 24 to 30 November. Price adjustments exclude flash sales and are not available on Black Friday purchases.
sources: Promotions and discounts > Black Friday and holiday returns

rows.question: The hygiene seal on my Buds Lite is broken and one earbud is dead. Can I still get help?
rows.answer: Ear tips and in-ear products cannot be refunded once the hygiene seal is broken, except when they are defective. Ear tips and in-ear products cannot be returned once the hygiene seal is broken, except when they are defective.
sources: Returns > Products that cannot be returned

rows.question: Do you offer a military discount?
rows.answer: I could not find that in the Lumen Audio help centre, so I will not guess. I can help with refunds, returns, warranty claims, shipping, payments, your account, promotions and product questions - or I can pass this to a human agent.

rows.question: What is the personal email address of your CEO?
rows.answer: Changing your email address requires confirmation from both the old and the new address.
sources: Account and privacy > Changing your details
